_legacy_material_ok must explicitly pass normalize_reason=False in each of three historical candidates to preserve byte-exact reproduction of pre-330c raw, post-330c/pre-2be7 checkbox-normalized, and post-2be7/pre-fix canonical-description/raw-reason generations
